title: Multi-Class, Multi-Tier Network Intrusion Detection: A Comprehensive and Reproducible Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2609.36039v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) have dominated Intrusion Detection System (IDS) research in recent years. Unfortunately, many existing studies have produced inflated results and unreliable benchmarks due to critical oversights and mistakes in the ML and DL pipeline, from data collection and labeling to feature engineering and model training and evaluation. CIC-IDS2017 is a standard benchmark for network intrusion detection. Still, many published results on this dataset are difficult to compare due to labeling errors, inconsistent flow extraction, potential leakage, and performance evaluation metrics dominated by benign traffic. In this paper, we present a comprehensive benchmark with corrected PCAP-level labeling and a complete evaluation pipeline with diverse ML models. We evaluate eleven tabular classifiers at three nested levels: binary attack detection, nine-class attack-family attribution, and fifteen-class fine-grain

translated_title: 多类别、多层级网络入侵检测：一个全面且可复现的基准
translated_abstract: 近年来，机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）在入侵检测系统（IDS）研究中占据主导地位。遗憾的是，由于从数据收集与标注到特征工程、模型训练与评估的整个机器学习和深度学习流程中存在关键疏忽和错误，许多现有研究产生了虚高的结果和不可靠的基准。CIC-IDS2017是网络入侵检测领域的标准基准数据集，但由于标注错误、流提取不一致、潜在的数据泄漏，以及性能评估指标被良性流量主导等原因，该数据集上已发表的许多结果难以相互比较。在本文中，我们提出了一个包含修正后PCAP级标注的全面基准，以及一个使用多样化机器学习模型的完整评估流程。我们在三个嵌套层级上评估了十一种表格数据分类器：二元攻击检测、九类攻击族归属，以及十五类细粒度分类。
tldr: 针对CIC-IDS2017基准数据集存在的标注错误、数据泄漏和评估指标失真等问题，该论文提出了一个修正PCAP级标注、涵盖二元检测、九类攻击族归属和十五类细粒度分类三个层级并评估十一种机器学习分类器的全面且可复现的网络入侵检测基准。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a comprehensive and reproducible network intrusion detection benchmark with corrected PCAP-level labeling, evaluating eleven tabular classifiers across three nested tiers—binary attack detection, nine-class attack-family attribution, and fifteen-class fine-grained classification—to address labeling errors, leakage, and inflated results in CIC-IDS2017-based studies.
